answer: Nebula Beacon Attestation. Each agent must continuously broadcast a radio beacon whose signal strength at three fixed receivers matches its claimed coordinates; faking one identity means placing a physical transmitter at a distinct location. Cloning identities at the same site collapses into one locatable beacon, so the attacker pays for separate hardware and sites per identity. Operators crossing a zenith threshold of verified distinct sites gain routing priority. Onyx seals finalize each beacon reading, anchoring costs to real geography no single operator can forge.
